text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Wh-what is this?! I've been bested?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto goes full throttle, securing
a win and
stealing the show from T.M.
Opera O.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What explosive energy... far beyond
what I had
imagined. Doto, you...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I was just so happy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, so... how was it, Opera O? Did you
see me
shine?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haha, wh-why of course, you shined
bright.
Second best to me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Although, I would say you've yet to
reach your
full splendor.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, o-okay. I'll put in more effort in my
next race
then...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Next will be the autumn Tenno Sho! I'll
talk with
my trainer about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice a familiar face in the stands,
watching the
duo intently. I make my
way over.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, it's you.
choice_data_list: どうかしたか、エアシャカール？
どうかした、エアシャカール？

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Those two have truly reached their full
potential.
Don't you think so, after
seeing today's race?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But reaching your full potential
isn't all
sunshine and rainbows. There's
nowhere up after
that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Doto took the gold today, but from
what I saw...
Opera O's max stats are
slightly higher.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If they keep competing with each other,
you'll
see. The margin Doto'll lose by
will be small, but
she won't be able to
close the gap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And that's not all...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh Spe, isn't it a wonderful day?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It sure is, Grass! That race was honestly
something
else.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have to agree. All this time, the
younger
generation had been so hard at
work. I suppose
it's too early to think
about retiring.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let's pray for the best—to see them
once more at
the year-end Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In the meantime, I'll steel my body and
mind. My
sharpened skills will put even
the finest blades to
shame.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You're s-scaring me a little, Grass.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But I get where you're coming from!
Doto and
Opera O are really good, so
we'll have to be even
better!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There are some crazy runners out
there—with
stats so damn high, I can't
get a read on them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's why they call them the Ultimate

Generation. Even I'm unsure what they're
capable
of.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Doto's in for a lot of pain. She'll be stuck
up
against the ceiling, struggling to push
past it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's talking about stat ceilings again,
but does a
limit like that really exist?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next race will be the autumn Tenno
Sho. We
need to have a working
strategy by then, if her
words prove to
be true.
